title: Erik Jansson - GPU driven Rendering with Mesh Shaders in Alan Wake 2
summary: A Remedy engineer explains how Alan Wake 2 moved to a GPU-driven rendering pipeline built on mesh shaders, culling and rendering meshlets for dense vegetation on PS5 and Xbox Series consoles.
why: HN points to it as a detailed production example of mesh shaders and GPU-driven rendering, though some find it daunting.

quote.text: A related talk of using Mesh shaders for Alan Wake 2
